note: Per-control-type property rules for the `properties` check in scripts/preflight.mjs, one entry per control identifier used in power/canvas/build/Src. `deny` lists property names Studio rejects on that control (PA2108); `allow`, where present, is the closed set of names permitted on it. Where a control's rules differ by variant, `variants` maps the variant name onto its own `deny`/`allow`, and that entry replaces the control-level one. `confirmed` names a property Studio has written on that control in a source we no longer hold, which the `confirmed` check (37) adds to the type's set alongside `allow` and the properties it reads out of the Studio-opened packages. Every entry is read off power/canvas/CONTROLS.md or a Studio rejection we have already paid for.
